description: Step 6 of Open Commerce Pathways: the real money in and out of the wallet that paid for your x402 compute runs, from Base USDC transfers we scan onchain since its first run. Income counts only x402 (EIP-3009) payments to that wallet; plain transfers in are deposits. Spend is split into our fees, route sellers and other. profit is true only when coverage is current and income exceeds spend. Free within the per-IP allowance, then $0.002. Live data only.
